name: Universal TV Text Two Columns
description: Splits long article text into two columns like a newspaper for widescreen TV

params.css: article, [role='article'], .post-content, .article-body, .entry-content, .story-body { column-count: 2 !important; column-gap: 40px !important; column-rule: 1px solid rgba(48,54,61,0.5) !important; } article h1, article h2, [role='article'] h1, [role='article'] h2, .article-body h1, .article-body h2 { column-span: all !important; } article img, [role='article'] img { max-width: 100% !important; }
